text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two Iraqi boats enter Kuwait's territorial waters.
- Acting Prime Minister and Forign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah congratulates French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin on taking office.

- Kuwait seen restoring ties with Jordan, Yemen. Kuwait's ties with the two fellow Arab states were badly strained over their perceived sympathy with Baghdad during Iraq's 1990-91 occupation of Kuwait.
- Police says bomb report at ministries' complex was hoax.
- Jordanian parliament speaker Saed Hayel Srour says resumption of ties with Kuwait awaits a Kuwaiti move.
- Information Minister Sheikh Saud Nasser al-Sabah, on a U.S. visit, says the Washington has reiterated its fixed position towards Kuwait.
- Parliamentarians seek comprehensive report on army deals.
- Ministry of Trade and Industry shuts down seven small firms for offering loans without authorisation. The penalty for such offence is a one-week closure.
